compaction.prepare.name: Prepare compaction early
compaction.prepare.description: When the context is nearly full, the older part is summarized in the background, so the switch happens without a wait when compaction is due. Off means compacting only once the limit is reached, as before.

log.level.name: Runtime log level
log.level.description: How much the runtime log records. Set debug when chasing a problem. MIYU_LOG, when set, wins for that launch.

ui.language.name: Interface language
ui.language.description: The language terminals, the web page and the command line use for you. auto follows the terminal or browser.

usage.currency.name: Currency shown first
usage.currency.description: Amounts are added up per currency, never converted. This one is listed first, the others by code. Three capital letters such as USD or CNY.

ui.startup.name: On start, open
ui.startup.description: Whether a terminal interface or the web page opens a new session or picks up the most recent one.

permission.start_read_only.name: Start new sessions read-only
permission.start_read_only.description: When on, new sessions begin read-only. She can look around and plan, and you turn read-only off when files should change. A project config can only turn it on.

models.chat.name: Chat model
models.chat.description: The model new sessions use, written as provider/model, for example deepseek/deepseek-flash, or @pool.

models.vision.name: Vision model
models.vision.description: Looks at images for the chat model when it cannot. Written like the chat model.

pools.<id>.models.name: Pool members
pools.<id>.models.description: A group of models, each written as provider/model.

pools.<id>.strategy.name: Pool strategy
pools.<id>.strategy.description: Keep a session on one member, or take the next member for every request. Left out, a pool whose members are all billed per request rotates and the others pin.

pools.<id>.subagent.name: Subagents can pick it
pools.<id>.subagent.description: When on, she can pick this pool for a subagent in new sessions. It is listed only once it has members.

pools.<id>.description.name: Description for the model
pools.<id>.description.description: One line she sees after the pool name when she starts a subagent. Write it in English.

providers.<id>.driver.name: Driver
providers.<id>.driver.description: How to talk to this provider. Known providers can leave it out.

providers.<id>.base_url.name: Address
providers.<id>.base_url.description: The address of this provider's API; the driver adds the path. Known providers can leave it out.

providers.<id>.keys.name: Keys
providers.<id>.keys.description: Write { secret = "name" } (saved with miyu login) or { env = "VARIABLE" }. Each session sticks to one of them. Empty means no auth header.

providers.<id>.name.name: Display name
providers.<id>.name.description: The name people see. The id is only for referring to models; without one, the model data's name for this provider is used, then the id.

providers.<id>.catalog.name: Catalog provider
providers.<id>.catalog.description: Which provider in the model data this one is, for example deepseek for a relay that only forwards DeepSeek.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.window.name: Context window
providers.<id>.models.<model>.window.description: The context window of this model, in tokens.

providers.<id>.price_multiplier.name: Price multiplier
providers.<id>.price_multiplier.description: Prices of this provider are multiplied by it. 1 if left out. A multiplier on the model wins.

providers.<id>.local.name: Local service
providers.<id>.local.description: A model service on this machine, counted as free. Left out, it follows the address: on this machine means yes.

providers.<id>.cache.name: Cache class
providers.<id>.cache.description: How this provider bills its cache. For now it only decides how a pool without a strategy splits. Left out, it follows the driver.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.catalog.name: Catalog entry
providers.<id>.models.<model>.catalog.description: Which models.dev entry to use: <provider>/<model>. Left out, it is found by name.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.max_output.name: Max output
providers.<id>.models.<model>.max_output.description: How many tokens this model can write at most in one reply.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.inputs.name: Inputs
providers.<id>.models.<model>.inputs.description: What this model can read: text, images, PDF, audio, video.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.tools.name: Tool calls
providers.<id>.models.<model>.tools.description: Whether this model can call tools.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.reasoning.name: Reasoning levels
providers.<id>.models.<model>.reasoning.description: Which reasoning levels this model offers.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.effort.name: Default reasoning effort
providers.<id>.models.<model>.effort.description: The reasoning effort this model uses by default: one of its levels, for example high, or off where thinking can be turned off. Left out, the provider decides.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.temperatur.name: Default temperature
providers.<id>.models.<model>.temperatur.description: The temperature this model uses by default, from 0 to 2; higher gives looser answers. Left out, the provider decides. Not sent to models that do not take one.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price_mult.name: Price multiplier
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price_mult.description: Prices of this model are multiplied by it, over the one on the provider.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.inpu.name: Input price
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.inpu.description: Price per million input tokens. A written price is used whole.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.cach.name: Cache read price
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.cach.description: Price per million tokens read from the cache.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.cach.name: Cache write price
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.cach.description: Price per million tokens written to the cache.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.curr.name: Currency
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.curr.description: Currency of the price, three capital letters such as USD or CNY. USD if left out.

models.catalog.update.name: Update the catalog
models.catalog.update.description: Fetch a newer model catalog from models.dev in the background. Off uses only the bundled and already fetched ones.

models.catalog.url.name: Catalog address
models.catalog.url.description: Where to fetch the model catalog from.

models.catalog.every.name: Update every
models.catalog.every.description: Fetch again once the cached catalog is this old.

models.cooldown.rate_limited.base.name: Rate limit cooldown
models.cooldown.rate_limited.base.description: How long an endpoint rests the first time it is rate limited. It doubles each time in a row.

models.cooldown.rate_limited.max.name: Rate limit cooldown cap
models.cooldown.rate_limited.max.description: The rate limit cooldown stops doubling here, even when the provider asks for longer.

models.cooldown.retryable.base.name: Error cooldown
models.cooldown.retryable.base.description: How long an endpoint rests the first time it cannot be reached or fails on its side. It doubles each time in a row.

models.cooldown.retryable.max.name: Error cooldown cap
models.cooldown.retryable.max.description: The cooldown for these errors stops doubling here.

models.cooldown.auth.base.name: Auth failure pause
models.cooldown.auth.base.description: How long a whole key rests the first time it fails to authenticate or runs out of quota. It doubles each time in a row.

models.cooldown.auth.max.name: Auth failure pause cap
models.cooldown.auth.max.description: The pause for a whole key stops doubling here.

external.bindings.<external>.name: Owner's platform accounts
external.bindings.<external>.description: Which platform identity is which local account. The key is the platform identity (for example qq:10001), the value is the local account. In private chats that identity is that account itself.

onebot.listen.name: QQ bridge port
onebot.listen.description: The port NapCat's reverse WebSocket connects to, local only. In NapCat use ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/onebot/v11/ws.

onebot.token.name: QQ bridge token
onebot.token.description: The access token NapCat shows when it connects; set the same one in NapCat. Write { secret = "name" } (saved with miyu login) or { env = "VARIABLE" }. Without it the QQ bridge does not start.

said.tool-results/not-an-object: the arguments are not a JSON object
said.tool-results/unattended: needs a confirmation nobody here can give
said.commands/workspace-too-wide: {asked} is too broad, so the workspace is now {cwd}.
said.software/basesystem/summary: Read and edit files, run commands, look up earlier talk
said.software/net/summary: Search the web and open pages
said.software/goal/summary: Keep working on one thing until it is done
said.software/memory/summary: Remember what you said and recall it later
said.persona-problems/unknown_table: Unknown table [{detail}]: persona.toml only takes [persona] and [memory]
said.persona-problems/unknown_language: {detail}: the language must be zh, en or ja
said.persona-problems/empty_phrase: {detail} must be text that is not empty
said.persona-problems/first_line: The first line must start with user:
said.persona-problems/take_turns: user and assistant must take turns
said.persona-problems/last_line: The last line must be the assistant's
said.persona-problems/pair_clash: Pair {pair} has a line that starts with user: or assistant:, so it cannot be saved
said.preset-problems/unknown_table: Unknown table [{detail}]: a preset only takes [preset], [software] and [tools]
said.preset-problems/unknown_language: {detail}: the language must be zh, en or ja
said.preset-problems/bad_persona: {detail} must be a persona id: a lowercase letter first, then lowercase letters, digits, - and _
said.preset-problems/bad_software: {detail}: a package id starts with a lowercase letter and has only lowercase letters, digits, - and _
said.preset-problems/bad_tool: {detail}: a tool name has only letters, digits, - and _, at most 64
said.preset-problems/not_false: {detail} can only be false: a preset can only turn single tools off
said.package-problems/unknown_table: Unknown table [{detail}]: a manifest only takes [package], [command], [process], [ui], [check] and [settings]
said.package-problems/wrong_kind: [{detail}] is not for this kind of package: [process] is only for kind = "process", [ui] only for kind = "ui"
said.package-problems/needs_command: [{detail}] needs a [command] to name the program
said.package-problems/bad_kind: package.kind must be ui or process, not {detail}
said.package-problems/bad_protocol: {detail} must be two non-negative integers [lowest, highest], the lowest not above the highest
said.package-problems/not_texts: {detail} must be a list of text
said.package-problems/not_phrases: {detail} must map languages to text; the languages are zh, en and ja
said.package-problems/unknown_language: {detail}: the language must be zh, en or ja
said.package-problems/bad_command_name: {detail} must start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and -
said.package-problems/bad_program: {detail} must be a program name without a path
said.package-problems/bad_page: {detail} must list page names in lowercase letters, digits, - and _
said.package-problems/bad_pages_dir: {detail} must be a relative directory inside the resource directory, without .. or a leading /
said.package-problems/duplicate: A shipped package is already called {detail}; this one does not count
said.package-problems/command_taken: The command {detail} is taken by another package; this one does not count
said.package-problems/protocol_mismatch: This package speaks protocol versions {detail}, and the core speaks 1; upgrade them to the same release
said.package-problems/bad_setting_name: {detail}: a setting name starts with a lowercase letter and uses only lowercase letters, digits and _
said.package-problems/bad_type: {detail} must be bool, int, option, text, name, url, secret or list
said.package-problems/bad_element: {detail} must be bool, int, option, text, name, url or secret; a list's element cannot be a list
said.package-problems/bad_default: {detail} does not fit the setting's type or is not one of its choices; a secret, or a list of secrets, has no default
said.package-problems/bad_choices: {detail} must list at least two different texts
said.package-problems/bad_range: {detail} must be integers, the lowest not above the highest
said.package-problems/bad_layers: {detail} must list system, personal or both
said.package-problems/bad_applies: {detail} must be now, new_session, next_turn or program_start
said.package-problems/settings_taken: The package id {detail} is also a core settings section, so none of its settings count; give it another id
said.package-problems/check_failed: The package's own check did not finish: {detail}
said.package-problems/check_unavailable: {detail} was not found, so the package's own check did not run
said.package-problems/check_output: The package's own check printed {detail} lines that are not problems; they were skipped
said.config/reference-header: Every Miyu setting and its default. This file is generated. Editing it has no effect.
said.config/reference-where: Write the system config in system/config.toml and personal settings in home/<account>/settings.toml.
said.config/applies/new_session: Applies to sessions opened from now on
said.config/applies/head_start: Takes effect the next time the program starts
said.config/secrets-header: Miyu's secrets: written, replaced and deleted only through Miyu. Do not share this file.
said.config/unknown-secret: {key} refers to the secret {name}, which is not set
said.config/env-not-set: {key} refers to {name}, which was not set when the core started
said.config/no-provider: {key} points at the provider {name}, which is not configured
said.config/no-pool: {key} points at the pool {name}, which is not configured
said.config/unknown-effort: {key} is {name}, which is not one of this model's levels now. Requests go out as if it were not set
said.config/temperature-unsupported: {key}: this model does not take a temperature. Requests go out as if it were not set
said.config/temperature-too-high: {key} is {got}, above this model's limit of {max}. Requests go out as if it were not set
said.config/bad-secret-name: {key} is not a valid secret name: start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters
said.config/bad-secret-value: The value of {key} must be quoted text, not empty
said.config/trust-header: Which project configs Miyu trusts: the repository, the exact content, and the answer.
said.config/too-big: The file is over 1 MiB and is not read
said.config/unknown-key: There is no {key}. Did you mean {suggest}?
said.config/wrong-layer: {key} belongs in {layers}. It does not count in {layer}
said.config/not-tightening: A project config can only make limits stricter. {key} is {current}, and {got} here is looser, so it does not count
said.config/untrusted-project: This project config is not trusted yet and is not used
said.config/kept: The line is ignored and kept as it is
said.config/using-last-good: Using what was read from this file last time
said.config/using-nothing: The file is not used for now
said.config/expected/english: one line of English, at most {max} characters
said.config/expected/duration: a length of time from {min} to {max}, written like 30s, 10m or 1h
said.config/expected/url: an address starting with http:// or https://
said.config/expected/name: a name starting with a lowercase letter, using only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters
said.config/expected/id: start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 32 characters
